name: arne
description: Routes each prompt and subagent run to the cheapest model and effort that can handle it, and manages the cache, compaction and model switches around it.

auto.title: Auto routing
auto.description: Route each prompt and subagent run. Off leaves the session model alone.

backend.title: Classifier
backend.description: Who decides the tier. laya needs laya-serve installed. jev is TypeSafe's hosted judge: prompts leave this machine; set the key in /config or TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

typesafe_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_key.description: Used only when Judge is Jev. Stored in secure storage, never in settings.json.

subagents.title: Subagents
subagents.description: Auto lets arne pick each subagent's model. Haiku, Sonnet or Opus is the dearest one a subagent may run on, a named one too. Off leaves subagents on the model they were spawned with.

effortCeiling.title: Highest effort
effortCeiling.description: Never think more than this. The judges stop at high; xhigh and max come from a pin or a floor.

compactModel.title: Compaction model
compactModel.description: The model that writes compaction summaries.

coldTokens.title: Cold offer above (tokens)
coldTokens.description: Offer the cold-cache actions on chats at least this big.

heavyTokens.title: Heavy warning above (tokens)
heavyTokens.description: The band warns about a chat this big.

continueAfterCompact.title: Continue after /compact
continueAfterCompact.description: After a manual compact, send "Continue where you left off." when the work stopped mid-task.
